{"parentUuid":"5d51a3b5-a5c5-46e9-9bac-ad04c656af54","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"e500254c-7403-4566-af68-0b085d37fcfb","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RjHy2mCr9jfFbZUcjc1UUJ","type":"tool_result","content":"title:\tSpec: Kenyon CGE study abroad CMS — all 7 capabilities\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nKenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement (CGE) wants its own site where student Ambassadors who've actually attended a program write about it, but CGE must review every post before it goes public — nothing unapproved can reach a reader, and an Ambassador must never be able to touch anyone else's writing or the site's structure.\n\n## Solution\n\nA CMS with two roles — **Staff** (admin) and **Ambassador** (editor), see `CONTEXT.md` — where Ambassadors write and submit Posts, Staff review and publish them, and the public site is a static export organized as Home → Continent → Country → Program, with Posts grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page. `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003`, `ADR-004` are the settled vocabulary and decisions this spec builds on; `notes/future-work.md` lists what's deliberately deferred.\n\n## User Stories\n\n**Login (capability 1)**\n1. As a Staff member, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access the admin console.\n2. As an Ambassador, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can write and manage my own posts.\n3. As any user, I want a wrong password refused without the response revealing whether the account exists, so that no one can probe for valid emails.\n4. As a deactivated user, I want my login refused, so that I can't access the system after my account is deactivated.\n5. As any logged-in user, I want to log out, so that I can end my session on a shared computer.\n\n**Roles (capability 2)**\n6. As a Staff member, I want every Ambassador capability available to me too, so that I can write and submit my own Posts without a second account.\n7. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from any admin-only route, so that I can't reach user management or page authoring.\n8. As an anonymous visitor, I want to be redirected to login when I request an admin route, so that the admin console stays private.\n\n**Posts: authoring and the review gate (capability 3, ADR-004)**\n9. As an Ambassador, I want to create a new draft Post under a Program, so that I can start writing about my experience there.\n10. As an Ambassador, I want to edit my own draft Post's title, body, and Topic, so that I can revise it before submitting.\n11. As an Ambassador, I want to delete my own draft Post, after confirming \"are you sure?\", so that I don't lose it to a misclick but can still abandon it.\n12. As an Ambassador, I want to submit my draft for review, so that CGE can decide whether to publish it.\n13. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from editing or deleting my Post once it's pending or published, so that nothing changes mid-review or after it's live without CGE knowing.\n14. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from touching another Ambassador's Post in any way, so that I can't edit, delete, or resubmit someone else's writing.\n15. As a Staff member, I want to publish a pending Post, so that it goes live on the public site.\n16. As a Staff member, I want to bounce a pending Post back to draft, so that its author can revise it before I reconsider.\n17. As a Staff member, I want to publish my own draft Post directly, so that I don't have to route my own work through a review queue.\n18. As a Staff member, I want the option to submit my own Post to pending instead, so that another Staff member can review it first.\n19. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Post regardless of status or author, so that I can fix a problem or remove content without waiting on anyone.\n20. As a Staff member, I want to unpublish a live Post back to draft, so that I can pull it down for a larger rewrite.\n\n**Pages and the content tree (capability 4)**\n21. As a Staff member, I want to create a Page nested under an existing Page (Home, a Continent, or a Country), so that I can build out the Continent → Country → Program tree.\n22. As a Staff member, I want to create a standalone Page directly under Home (e.g. \"About CGE\"), so that I can publish information that isn't travel content.\n23. As a Staff member, I want to flag a Page to show in the footer, so that standalone pages are reachable without cluttering the main navigation.\n24. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Page, so that I can keep the site's structure current as programs change.\n25. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from creating, editing, or deleting any Page, so that the site's structure stays under CGE's control.\n\n**Topic (ADR-004 scope note, field notes)**\n26. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want its Posts grouped by Topic, so that I can jump straight to Housing or Academics instead of scrolling through everything.\n27. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want to filter to one Topic or see everything, so that I only see what I'm looking for.\n28. As an Ambassador, I want to tag my Post with a Topic when I write it, so that it lands in the right section of the Program page.\n\n**Public navigation (field notes, client brief)**\n29. As a visitor on any public page, I want a nav bar with Home and the Continents, so that I can jump to a different region from anywhere.\n30. As a visitor drilled into a Program page, I want a breadcrumb trail (Home → Continent → Country → Program), so that I can see where I am and step back up a level at a time.\n31. As a visitor, I want a footer linking to standalone pages like \"About CGE\" and \"Contact Us\", so that I can find that information from anywhere on the site.\n32. As a visitor on a phone, I want the nav bar to wrap or collapse, so that it never runs off the screen.\n\n**Admin console (capability 5)**\n33. As a Staff member, I want my admin home screen to be a live preview of the site, so that I land on what's actually published, the way WordPress's own admin works.\n34. As a Staff member, I want a Dashboard tab with counts (Posts by status, Pages by level, active accounts), so that I can see the state of the whole site at a glance.\n35. As a Staff member, I want a Pending queue tab listing every Post waiting on a decision, so that nothing sits unreviewed because no one thought to check.\n36. As a Staff member, I want a Metrics tab showing Posts per Program, so that I can see which programs have no Ambassador content yet.\n37. As an Ambassador, I want a \"My posts\" view listing my own drafts, pending, and published Posts, so that I can track what I've written without seeing anyone else's.\n\n**User management (capability 6)**\n38. As a Staff member, I want an Accounts tab to create users, assign a role, and activate/deactivate an account, so that I can manage who has access.\n39. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Ambassador's draft Posts deleted automatically, so that the content list doesn't fill up with abandoned half-finished student work.\n40. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Staff colleague's drafts left in place, viewable, editable, publishable, and deletable by any other Staff member just like any other content, so that CGE's own unfinished work isn't lost just because whoever started it left.\n41. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated user's pending and published content left exactly as it is, so that I can still publish what's in the queue and readers keep seeing valuable published content.\n42. As a visitor, I want a published Post to keep showing its original author's name even after that account is deactivated, so that the byline stays honest.\n\n**Public site and publish (capability 7)**\n43. As a Staff member, I want `cms publish` to write only published Posts and Pages into `site/`, so that nothing in draft or pending ever leaks to the public.\n44. As a Staff member, I want every link and asset in the exported HTML to be relative, so that the site works on its GitHub Pages subpath.\n45. As a visitor, I want a Post's Markdown rendered as sanitized HTML, so that nothing an Ambassador wrote can inject a script into the page I'm reading.\n46. As a Staff member, I want a slug frozen the instant something is published, so that a link a reader has already shared never breaks.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Module split** (new, per this spec): `app/models.py` — plain SQLite access (no ORM, per ADR-002), `User`/`Page`/`Post` reads and writes. `app/services/` — pure rules with no FastAPI or SQLite dependency: slug generation, the status state machine, the deactivation cascade. `app/routes/` — thin HTTP handlers that call services for decisions and models for persistence. `templates/` — unchanged, `admin/` and `public/` subtrees as already established.\n\n**Data model** (logical, fields not file-bound):\n- `User`: id, email, password_hash (argon2), role (`admin`/`editor`), display_name, active (bool), timestamps.\n- `Page`: id, parent_id (nullable only for Home), title, slug, body (Markdown), status (`draft`/`published` — **no `pending`**: only Staff author Pages, and Staff can self-publish, so there's never a reviewer to wait on), `show_in_footer` (bool), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n- `Post`: id, program_id (must reference a Program-level Page), title, slug, body (Markdown), topic (`general`/`housing`/`meals`/`social-life`/`academics`/`other`), status (`draft`/`pending`/`published`), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n\n**Status state machine** (services layer; a decision this precise is clearer as a table than prose):\n\n| From | Action | Who | To |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| draft | submit | the Post's own author (any role) | pending |\n| pending | publish | any admin | published |\n| pending | bounce | any admin | draft |\n| draft | self-publish | admin, **own Post only** | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin | draft |\n\nNo other transition exists. In particular, an admin cannot move *someone else's* draft straight to published — it must be submitted to pending first, same as anyone's. This keeps \"an Ambassador's post is never published without someone deciding to put it through pending\" true even when the decider is an admin, not just an Ambassador.\n\n**Content edit/delete permission** (orthogonal to status, from `CONTEXT.md`'s Staff/Ambassador entries): admin — any Post or Page, any status, always. Editor — only their own Post, only while draft. Never any Page.\n\n**Slug generation**: derived from title (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to hyphens). Regenerates on every title change while status is draft; frozen the moment status leaves draft, even if an admin edits the title afterward. On a collision with a sibling under the same parent, append `-2`, `-3`, … — not grilled explicitly; flagged below.\n\n**Deactivation cascade** (services layer): the cascade is role-specific, not uniform. Deactivating an **Ambassador** deletes their draft Posts — nothing worth keeping from a student who's left. Deactivating a **Staff member** deletes nothing: their drafts (Posts or Pages) stay exactly as they are, and since admin permission is \"any Post or Page, any status, always\" (see Content edit/delete permission above), any other Staff member can already view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content — Staff drafts are usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a departing student's. Pending and published content is left untouched regardless of which role is deactivated, byline intact.\n\n**Public URL / nav contract**: a Page's public path is the slug chain of its ancestors from Home (Home = site root); a Post's path nests under its Program's path. A footer-flagged standalone Page still gets a path under Home, just excluded from Home's own child listing (`CONTEXT.md`, Page).\n\n**Admin console layout**: Staff's landing screen is a live preview of the site inside the console; sidebar tabs are Dashboard, Pending queue, Accounts, Page hierarchy, Metrics. Ambassador's sidebar is just \"My posts\". No reviewer assignment and no notifications on the pending queue — any admin can act on any pending Post.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test asserts externally observable behavior — status code, redirect target, response HTML, a written file's contents, or a service function's return value/raised error — never an internal implementation detail.\n\n- **HTTP seam** (`TestClient`, prior art: `tests/test_t00.py`, `conftest.py`'s `client_as(role)`): login success/failure/deactivated, every admin-only route rejected for an editor and for an anonymous request, Post/Page CRUD and every status-transition route end-to-end, CSRF rejection on a POST with the token stripped, the Dashboard/Pending-queue/Accounts/Metrics/My-posts screens, nav bar/breadcrumb/footer HTML on public pages.\n- **`render_site()` seam** (prior art: `test_publish_writes_a_site`, `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths`): a draft or pending Post/Page present but absent from the output, every href/src relative, sanitized Markdown in the exported HTML, a frozen slug surviving a post-publish title edit, nav/breadcrumb/footer present in the static files.\n- **Services seam** (new, no HTTP or DB — plain pytest functions): every cell of the status state-machine table including the disallowed combinations (e.g. editor attempting publish, admin attempting draft→published on someone else's Post), slug generation and its collision suffixing, the deactivation cascade's decision of which Posts/Pages to delete vs. keep.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"2199afc7-f66e-401c-bd7a-1c4cbd3b58dd","timestamp":"2026-10-06T18:42:46.742Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"title:\tSpec: Kenyon CGE study abroad CMS — all 7 capabilities\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nKenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). As any logged-in user, I want to log out, so that I can end my session on a shared computer.\n\n**Roles (capability 2)**\n6. As a Staff member, I want every Ambassador capability available to me too, so that I can write and submit my own Posts without a second account.\n7. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from any admin-only route, so that I can't reach user management or page authoring.\n8. As an anonymous visitor, I want to be redirected to login when I request an admin route, so that the admin console stays private.\n\n**Posts: authoring and the review gate (capability 3, ADR-004)**\n9. As an Ambassador, I want to create a new draft Post under a Program, so that I can start writing about my experience there.\n10. As an Ambassador, I want to edit my own draft Post's title, body, and Topic, so that I can revise it before submitting.\n11. As an Ambassador, I want to delete my own draft Post, after confirming \"are you sure?\", so that I don't lose it to a misclick but can still abandon it.\n12. As an Ambassador, I want to submit my draft for review, so that CGE can decide whether to publish it.\n13. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from editing or deleting my Post once it's pending or published, so that nothing changes mid-review or after it's live without CGE knowing.\n14. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from touching another Ambassador's Post in any way, so that I can't edit, delete, or resubmit someone else's writing.\n15. As a Staff member, I want to publish a pending Post, so that it goes live on the public site.\n16. As a Staff member, I want to bounce a pending Post back to draft, so that its author can revise it before I reconsider.\n17. As a Staff member, I want to publish my own draft Post directly, so that I don't have to route my own work through a review queue.\n18. As a Staff member, I want the option to submit my own Post to pending instead, so that another Staff member can review it first.\n19. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Post regardless of status or author, so that I can fix a problem or remove content without waiting on anyone.\n20. As a Staff member, I want to unpublish a live Post back to draft, so that I can pull it down for a larger rewrite.\n\n**Pages and the content tree (capability 4)**\n21. As a Staff member, I want to create a Page nested under an existing Page (Home, a Continent, or a Country), so that I can build out the Continent → Country → Program tree.\n22. As a Staff member, I want to create a standalone Page directly under Home (e.g. \"About CGE\"), so that I can publish information that isn't travel content.\n23. As a Staff member, I want to flag a Page to show in the footer, so that standalone pages are reachable without cluttering the main navigation.\n24. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Page, so that I can keep the site's structure current as programs change.\n25. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from creating, editing, or deleting any Page, so that the site's structure stays under CGE's control.\n\n**Topic (ADR-004 scope note, field notes)**\n26. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want its Posts grouped by Topic, so that I can jump straight to Housing or Academics instead of scrolling through everything.\n27. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want to filter to one Topic or see everything, so that I only see what I'm looking for.\n28. As an Ambassador, I want to tag my Post with a Topic when I write it, so that it lands in the right section of the Program page.\n\n**Public navigation (field notes, client brief)**\n29. As a visitor on any public page, I want a nav bar with Home and the Continents, so that I can jump to a different region from anywhere.\n30. As a visitor drilled into a Program page, I want a breadcrumb trail (Home → Continent → Country → Program), so that I can see where I am and step back up a level at a time.\n31. As a visitor, I want a footer linking to standalone pages like \"About CGE\" and \"Contact Us\", so that I can find that information from anywhere on the site.\n32. As a visitor on a phone, I want the nav bar to wrap or collapse, so that it never runs off the screen.\n\n**Admin console (capability 5)**\n33. As a Staff member, I want my admin home screen to be a live preview of the site, so that I land on what's actually published, the way WordPress's own admin works.\n34. As a Staff member, I want a Dashboard tab with counts (Posts by status, Pages by level, active accounts), so that I can see the state of the whole site at a glance.\n35. As a Staff member, I want a Pending queue tab listing every Post waiting on a decision, so that nothing sits unreviewed because no one thought to check.\n36. As a Staff member, I want a Metrics tab showing Posts per Program, so that I can see which programs have no Ambassador content yet.\n37. As an Ambassador, I want a \"My posts\" view listing my own drafts, pending, and published Posts, so that I can track what I've written without seeing anyone else's.\n\n**User management (capability 6)**\n38. As a Staff member, I want an Accounts tab to create users, assign a role, and activate/deactivate an account, so that I can manage who has access.\n39. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Ambassador's draft Posts deleted automatically, so that the content list doesn't fill up with abandoned half-finished student work.\n40. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Staff colleague's drafts left in place, viewable, editable, publishable, and deletable by any other Staff member just like any other content, so that CGE's own unfinished work isn't lost just because whoever started it left.\n41. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated user's pending and published content left exactly as it is, so that I can still publish what's in the queue and readers keep seeing valuable published content.\n42. As a visitor, I want a published Post to keep showing its original author's name even after that account is deactivated, so that the byline stays honest.\n\n**Public site and publish (capability 7)**\n43. As a Staff member, I want `cms publish` to write only published Posts and Pages into `site/`, so that nothing in draft or pending ever leaks to the public.\n44. As a Staff member, I want every link and asset in the exported HTML to be relative, so that the site works on its GitHub Pages subpath.\n45. As a visitor, I want a Post's Markdown rendered as sanitized HTML, so that nothing an Ambassador wrote can inject a script into the page I'm reading.\n46. As a Staff member, I want a slug frozen the instant something is published, so that a link a reader has already shared never breaks.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Module split** (new, per this spec): `app/models.py` — plain SQLite access (no ORM, per ADR-002), `User`/`Page`/`Post` reads and writes. `app/services/` — pure rules with no FastAPI or SQLite dependency: slug generation, the status state machine, the deactivation cascade. `app/routes/` — thin HTTP handlers that call services for decisions and models for persistence. `templates/` — unchanged, `admin/` and `public/` subtrees as already established.\n\n**Data model** (logical, fields not file-bound):\n- `User`: id, email, password_hash (argon2), role (`admin`/`editor`), display_name, active (bool), timestamps.\n- `Page`: id, parent_id (nullable only for Home), title, slug, body (Markdown), status (`draft`/`published` — **no `pending`**: only Staff author Pages, and Staff can self-publish, so there's never a reviewer to wait on), `show_in_footer` (bool), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n- `Post`: id, program_id (must reference a Program-level Page), title, slug, body (Markdown), topic (`general`/`housing`/`meals`/`social-life`/`academics`/`other`), status (`draft`/`pending`/`published`), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n\n**Status state machine** (services layer; a decision this precise is clearer as a table than prose):\n\n| From | Action | Who | To |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| draft | submit | the Post's own author (any role) | pending |\n| pending | publish | any admin | published |\n| pending | bounce | any admin | draft |\n| draft | self-publish | admin, **own Post only** | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin | draft |\n\nNo other transition exists. In particular, an admin cannot move *someone else's* draft straight to published — it must be submitted to pending first, same as anyone's. This keeps \"an Ambassador's post is never published without someone deciding to put it through pending\" true even when the decider is an admin, not just an Ambassador.\n\n**Content edit/delete permission** (orthogonal to status, from `CONTEXT.md`'s Staff/Ambassador entries): admin — any Post or Page, any status, always. Editor — only their own Post, only while draft. Never any Page.\n\n**Slug generation**: derived from title (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to hyphens). Regenerates on every title change while status is draft; frozen the moment status leaves draft, even if an admin edits the title afterward. On a collision with a sibling under the same parent, append `-2`, `-3`, … — not grilled explicitly; flagged below.\n\n**Deactivation cascade** (services layer): the cascade is role-specific, not uniform. Deactivating an **Ambassador** deletes their draft Posts — nothing worth keeping from a student who's left. Deactivating a **Staff member** deletes nothing: their drafts (Posts or Pages) stay exactly as they are, and since admin permission is \"any Post or Page, any status, always\" (see Content edit/delete permission above), any other Staff member can already view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content — Staff drafts are usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a departing student's. Pending and published content is left untouched regardless of which role is deactivated, byline intact.\n\n**Public URL / nav contract**: a Page's public path is the slug chain of its ancestors from Home (Home = site root); a Post's path nests under its Program's path. A footer-flagged standalone Page still gets a path under Home, just excluded from Home's own child listing (`CONTEXT.md`, Page).\n\n**Admin console layout**: Staff's landing screen is a live preview of the site inside the console; sidebar tabs are Dashboard, Pending queue, Accounts, Page hierarchy, Metrics. Ambassador's sidebar is just \"My posts\". No reviewer assignment and no notifications on the pending queue — any admin can act on any pending Post.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test asserts externally observable behavior — status code, redirect target, response HTML, a written file's contents, or a service function's return value/raised error — never an internal implementation detail.\n\n- **HTTP seam** (`TestClient`, prior art: `tests/test_t00.py`, `conftest.py`'s `client_as(role)`): login success/failure/deactivated, every admin-only route rejected for an editor and for an anonymous request, Post/Page CRUD and every status-transition route end-to-end, CSRF rejection on a POST with the token stripped, the Dashboard/Pending-queue/Accounts/Metrics/My-posts screens, nav bar/breadcrumb/footer HTML on public pages.\n- **`render_site()` seam** (prior art: `test_publish_writes_a_site`, `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths`): a draft or pending Post/Page present but absent from the output, every href/src relative, sanitized Markdown in the exported HTML, a frozen slug surviving a post-publish title edit, nav/breadcrumb/footer present in the static files.\n- **Services seam** (new, no HTTP or DB — plain pytest functions): every cell of the status state-machine table including the disallowed combinations (e.g. editor attempting publish, admin attempting draft→published on someone else's Post), slug generation and its collision suffixing, the deactivation cascade's decision of which Posts/Pages to delete vs. keep.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5d51a3b5-a5c5-46e9-9bac-ad04c656af54","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d420dbb7-4878-4683-a6c8-218b3923ca88","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{{ post.published_date }}</p>\n28\t              </li>\n29\t            {% endfor %}\n30\t          </ul>\n31\t        </section>\n32\t      {% endfor %}\n33\t      <script>\n34\t        (function () {\n35\t          var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(\".topic-pill\");\n36\t          var groups = document.querySelectorAll(\".post-topic-group\");\n37\t          buttons.forEach(function (btn) {\n38\t            btn.addEventListener(\"click\", function () {\n39\t              buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove(\"is-active\"); });\n40\t              btn.classList.add(\"is-active\");\n41\t              var topic = btn.getAttribute(\"data-topic\");\n42\t              groups.forEach(function (g) {\n43\t                g.hidden = topic !== \"all\" && g.getAttribute(\"data-topic\") !== topic;\n44\t              });\n45\t            });\n46\t          });\n47\t        })();\n48\t      </script>\n49\t    {% else %}\n50\t      <p>No posts yet.</p>\n51\t    {% endif %}\n52\t  {% endif %}\n53\t{% endblock %}\n54\t"}]},"uuid":"cf4fdc84-b6ac-4f96-b15f-4ad0047ee8b8","timestamp":"2026-10-06T18:42:46.850Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/public/page.html","content":"{% extends \"public/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ page.title }}</h1>\n  {{ body_html | safe }}\n  {% if children %}\n    <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n      {% for item in children %}\n        <li class=\"card\"><a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></li>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </ul>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if post_groups is not none %}\n    {% if post_groups %}\n      <div class=\"topic-filters\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Filter by Topic\">\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill is-active\" data-topic=\"all\">All</button>\n        {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n          <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</button>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </div>\n      {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n        <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n          <h2>{{ topic_label }}</h2>\n          <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n            {% for post in posts %}\n              <li class=\"card post-card\">\n                <a href=\"{{ post.href }}\">{{ post.title }}</a>\n                <p class=\"post-meta\">{{ post.author_name }} &middot; {{ post.published_date }}</p>\n              </li>\n            {% endfor %}\n          </ul>\n        </section>\n      {% endfor %}\n      <script>\n        (function () {\n          var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(\".topic-pill\");\n          var groups = document.querySelectorAll(\".post-topic-group\");\n          buttons.forEach(function (btn) {\n            btn.addEventListener(\"click\", function () {\n              buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove(\"is-active\"); });\n              btn.classList.add(\"is-active\");\n              var topic = btn.getAttribute(\"data-topic\");\n              groups.forEach(function (g) {\n                g.hidden = topic !== \"all\" && g.getAttribute(\"data-topic\") !== topic;\n              });\n            });\n          });\n        })();\n      </script>\n    {% else %}\n      <p>No posts yet.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n","numLines":54,"startLine":1,"totalLines":54}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"259e2fe5-f6be-48d0-8632-0b301986a391","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d420dbb7-4878-4683-a6c8-218b3923ca88","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

post_view\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple, per the T05 design acceptance. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n { text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; }\n.post-meta { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #5a5064; margin: 0.35rem 0 0; }\n.post-topic-badge {\n  display: inline-block;\n  background: var(--purple);\n  color: #fff;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.15rem 0.75rem;\n  font-size: 0.8rem;\n  font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.topic-filters {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem;\n  margin: {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 480px) {\n  .site-nav, .site-footer-nav { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; }\n  .card-grid { Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _topic_section(html: str, topic: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The contents of one Topic's <section>, distinct from a same-named\n    filter <button> (identified by its own \"post-topic-group\" class).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(\n        rf'<section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{topic}\">(.*?)</section>',\n        html, re.S,\n    )\n    assert match, f\"no post-topic-group section for topic={topic!r}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    # Each Post sits inside its OWN Topic's <section>, not just anywhere on\n    # the page — a loose \"is the word present\" check wouldn't tell the two\n    # Topics' Posts apart.\n    housing_section = _topic_section(response.text, \"housing\")\n    meals_section = _topic_section(response.text, \"meals\")\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in housing_section\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" not in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" not in housing_section\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not \"Social Life\" in program_html\n\n    post_html = post_html_path.read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in post_html and 'src=\"/' not in post_html\n    assert \"A Great Week\" in post_html\n    # A Post's page lives one level deeper than its Program (asia/japan/\n    # kyoto-exchange/<slug>/), so every furniture link — breadcrumb included,\n    # not just nav — must climb 4 \"../\", or it 404s published = [\n        p for program in programs\n        for p in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n    ]\n    assert published\n    for program in programs:\n        program_chain }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></li>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </ul>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% if post_groups is not none %}\n    {% if post_groups %}\n      <div class=\"topic-filters\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Filter by Topic\">\n        <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill is-active\" data-topic=\"all\">All</button>\n        {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n          <button type=\"button\" class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">{{ topic_label }}</button>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </div>\n      {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n        <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n          <h2>{{ topic_label }}</h2>\n          <ul class=\"card-grid\">\n            {% for post in posts %}\n              <li class=\"card post-card\">\n                <a href=\"{{ post.href }}\">{{ post.title }}</a>\n                <p class=\"post-meta\">{{ post.author_name }} &middot; {{ post.published_date }}</p>\n              </li>\n            {% endfor %}\n          </ul>\n        </section>\n      {% endfor %}\n      <script>\n        (function () {\n          var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(\".topic-pill\");\n          var groups = document.querySelectorAll(\".post-topic-group\");\n          buttons.forEach(function (btn) {\n            btn.addEventListener(\"click\", function () {\n              buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove(\"is-active\"); });\n              btn.classList.add(\"is-active\");\n              var topic = btn.getAttribute(\"data-topic\");\n              groups.forEach(function (g) {\n                g.hidden = topic !== \"all\" && g.getAttribute(\"data-topic\") !== topic;\n              });\n            });\n          });\n        })();\n      </script>\n    {% else %}\n      <p>No posts yet.</p>\n    {% endif %}\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import --ink: #1F1626;\n  --card-border: #DCCFEA;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  max-width: 60rem;\n  padding: 0 1rem 2rem;\n  color: autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _slug_chain(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> list[str]:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return []\n    return [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n\n\ndef _relative_link(from_chain: list[str], to_chain: list[str]) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * len(from_chain)\n    if not to_chain:\n        return f\"{up}index.html\" if up else \"index.html\"\n    return f\"{up}{'/'.join(to_chain)}/index.html\"\n\n\ndef _furniture(\n    chain: list[str],\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    footer_pages: list[models.Page],\n    chains: dict[int, list[str]],\n) -> tuple[str, list[dict], list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"CSS path, nav, and footer links for the page/post living at `chain` —\n    shared between a Page's own render and each of its Posts' renders.\"\"\"\n    css_path = _relative_link(chain, [])[: -len(\"index.html\")] + \"style.css\"\n    nav = [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, [])}] + [\n        {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n        for c in continents\n    ]\n    footer_links = [\n        {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[f.id])}\n        for f in footer_pages\n    ]\n    return css_path, nav, footer_links\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: _slug_chain(p, home) for p in all_pages}\n\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n\n    page_template = env.get_template(\"public/page.html\")\n    post_template = env.get_template(\"public/post.html\")\n\n    for page in all_pages:\n        if page.status != \"published\":\n            continue\n        chain = chains[page.id]\n        css_path, nav, footer_links = _furniture(chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains)\n        breadcrumb = [\n            {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[a.id])}\n            for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n        ] + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chain)}]\n        children = [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n            for c in models.list_published_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n        post_groups = None\n        if models.is_program_page(page):\n            posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n            post_groups = title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            body_html=markdown.render(page.body),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n            breadcrumb=breadcrumb,\n            footer_links=footer_links,\n            children=children,\n            post_groups=post_groups,\n        )\n\n        page_dir = out.joinpath(*chain) if chain else out\n        page_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        (page_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(html)\n\n        if not post_groups:\n            continue\n        for _topic_value, _topic_label, summaries in post_groups:\n            for summary in summaries:\n                post = summary[\"post\"]\n                post_chain = chain + [post.slug]\n                post_css_path, post_nav, _relative_link(post_chain, chain)},\n                    {\"title\": post.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, post_chain)},\n                ]\n                post_html = post_template.render(\n                    title=post.title,\n                    post=post,\n                    topic_label=summary[\"topic_label\"],\n                    author_name=summary[\"author_name\"],\n                    published_date=summary[\"published_date\"],\n                    body_html=markdown.render(post.body),\n                    css_path=post_css_path,\n                    nav=post_nav,\n                    breadcrumb=post_breadcrumb,\n                    footer_links=post_footer_links,\n                    program_href=_relative_link(post_chain, chain),\n                    program_title=page.title,\n                )\n                post_dir = out.joinpath(*post_chain)\n                post_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n                (post_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(post_html)\n\n    return Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft or pending Post, like a\n     draft Page, reaching site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple plus a warm gold accent, per the T10 design pass. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --card-border: #DCCFEA;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.65 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-x: hidden;\n}\nh1, h2, h3 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n.wrap {\n  max-width: 72rem;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 1.25rem;\n}\n\n/* -- header / nav -------------------------------------------------- */\n.site-header {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  padding: 1rem 0;\n}\n.site-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;\n}\n.site-nav a { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }\n.site-nav a:hover { color: var(--gold); text-decoration: none; }\n\n.breadcrumb {\n  font-size: 0.9rem;\n  margin-block: 1rem;\n  color: var(--muted);\n}\n.breadcrumb a { color: inherit; }\n\nmain { display: block; padding-bottom: 2rem; }\n\n/* -- hero (Home only) ----------------------------------------------- */\n.hero {\n  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--purple-dark) 100%);\n  color: #fff;\n  padding: 4rem 0 3.5rem;\n  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;\n}\n.hero h1 {\n  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);\n  margin: 0 0 1rem;\n}\n.hero-body {\n  max-width: 42rem;\n  font-size: 1.15rem;\n  color: #EDE3F7;\n}\n.hero-body :first-child { margin-top: 0; }\n\n.page-title {\n  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);\n  margin: 2rem 0 1rem;\n}\n\n/* -- card grids: Continents, Countries, Programs -------------------- */\n.card-grid {\n  list-style: none;\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15rem, 1fr));\n  gap: 1.25rem;\n  margin: 1.5rem 0;\n  padding: 0;\n}\n.card {\n  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n  border-radius: 0.75rem;\n  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;\n}\n.card:hover {\n  transform: translateY(-2px);\n  border-color: var(--gold);\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -10px rgba(31, 22, 38, 0.35);\n}\n.card a {\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n}\n.post-meta { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); margin: 0.35rem 0 0; }\n.post-topic-badge {\n  display: inline-block;\n  background: var(--gold);\n  color: #fff;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.2rem 0.85rem;\n  font-size: 0.8rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n.topic-filters {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 1.5rem 0;\n}\n.topic-pill {\n  border: 1px solid var(--purple);\n  background: #fff;\n  color: var(--purple-dark);\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n.topic-pill.is-active { background: var(--purple); color: #fff; border-color: var(--purple); }\n\n.post-topic-group h2 { margin-top: 2.5rem; }\n\n/* -- a single post --------------------------------------------------- */\n.post h1 { margin-top: 0.75rem; }\n.post-back { margin-top: 2.5rem; }\n\n/* -- footer ----------------------------------------------------------- */\n.site-footer {\n  background: var(--purple-dark);\n  color: #D9CBE8;\n  margin-top: 2rem;\n  padding: 2rem 0 1.5rem;\n}\n.site-footer-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;\n  margin-bottom: 1rem;\n}\n.site-footer-nav a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }\n.site-footer-nav a:hover { color: var(--gold); }\n.footer-note { color: #B6A3C7; }\n\n@media (max-width: 480px) {\n  .site-nav, .site-footer-nav { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }\n  .card-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }\n  .hero { padding: 2.5rem 0; }\n  .wrap { padding: 0 1rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _slug_chain(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> list[str]:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return []\n    return [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n\n\ndef _relative_link(from_chain: list[str], to_chain: list[str]) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * len(from_chain)\n    if not to_chain:\n        return f\"{up}index.html\" if up else \"index.html\"\n    return f\"{up}{'/'.join(to_chain)}/index.html\"\n\n\ndef _furniture(\n    chain: list[str],\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    footer_pages: list[models.Page],\n    chains: dict[int, list[str]],\n) -> tuple[str, list[dict], list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"CSS path, nav, and footer links for the page/post living at `chain` —\n    shared between a Page's own render and each of its Posts' renders.\"\"\"\n    css_path = _relative_link(chain, [])[: -len(\"index.html\")] + \"style.css\"\n    nav = [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, [])}] + [\n        {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n        for c in continents\n    ]\n    footer_links = [\n        {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[f.id])}\n        for f in footer_pages\n    ]\n    return css_path, nav, footer_links\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: _slug_chain(p, home) for p in all_pages}\n\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n\n    page_template = env.get_template(\"public/page.html\")\n    post_template = env.get_template(\"public/post.html\")\n\n    for page in all_pages:\n        if page.status != \"published\":\n            continue\n        chain = chains[page.id]\n        css_path, nav, footer_links = _furniture(chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains)\n        breadcrumb = [\n            {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[a.id])}\n            for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n        ] + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chain)}]\n        children = [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n            for c in models.list_published_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n        post_groups = None\n        if models.is_program_page(page):\n            posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n            post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n                posts, lambda post: _relative_link(chain, chain + [post.slug])\n            )\n\n        html = page_template.render(\n            title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            body_html=markdown.render(page.body),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n            breadcrumb=breadcrumb,\n            footer_links=footer_links,\n            children=children,\n            post_groups=post_groups,\n        )\n\n        page_dir = out.joinpath(*chain) if chain else out\n        page_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        (page_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(html)\n\n        if not post_groups:\n            continue\n        for _topic_value, _topic_label, summaries in post_groups:\n            for summary in summaries:\n                post = summary[\"post\"]\n                post_chain = chain + [post.slug]\n                post_css_path, post_nav, post_footer_links = _furniture(\n                    post_chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains\n                )\n                post_breadcrumb = [\n                    {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, chains[a.id])}\n                    for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n                ] + [\n                    {\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, chain)},\n                    {\"title\": post.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, post_chain)},\n                ]\n                post_html = post_template.render(\n                    title=post.title,\n                    post=post,\n                    topic_label=summary[\"topic_label\"],\n                    author_name=summary[\"author_name\"],\n                    published_date=summary[\"published_date\"],\n                    body_html=markdown.render(post.body),\n                    css_path=post_css_path,\n                    nav=post_nav,\n                    breadcrumb=post_breadcrumb,\n                    footer_links=post_footer_links,\n                    program_href=_relative_link(post_chain, chain),\n                    program_title=page.title,\n                )\n                post_dir = out.joinpath(*post_chain)\n                post_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n                (post_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(post_html)\n\n    return Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple plus a warm gold accent, per the T10 design pass. */\n:root {\n  color-scheme: light dark;\n  --purple: #5B2A86;\n  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n  --gold: #C98A3B;\n  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n  --ink: #1F1626;\n  --muted: #5a5064;\n  --card-border: #DCCFEA;\n  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.65 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-x: hidden;\n}\nh1, h2, h3 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n.wrap {\n  max-width: 72rem;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 1.25rem;\n}\n\n/* -- header / nav -------------------------------------------------- */\n.site-header {\n  background: var(--purple);\n  padding: 1rem 0;\n}\n.site-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;\n}\n.site-nav a { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }\n.site-nav a:hover { color: var(--gold); text-decoration: none; }\n\n.breadcrumb {\n  font-size: 0.9rem;\n  margin-block: 1rem;\n  color: var(--muted);\n}\n.breadcrumb a { color: inherit; }\n\nmain { display: block; padding-bottom: 2rem; }\n\n/* -- hero (Home only) ----------------------------------------------- */\n.hero {\n  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--purple-dark) 100%);\n  color: #fff;\n  padding: 4rem 0 3.5rem;\n  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;\n}\n.hero h1 {\n  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);\n  margin: 0 0 1rem;\n}\n.hero-body {\n  max-width: 42rem;\n  font-size: 1.15rem;\n  color: #EDE3F7;\n}\n.hero-body :first-child { margin-top: 0; }\n\n.page-title {\n  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);\n  margin: 2rem 0 1rem;\n}\n\n/* -- card grids: Continents, Countries, Programs -------------------- */\n.card-grid {\n  list-style: none;\n  display: grid;\n  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15rem, 1fr));\n  gap: 1.25rem;\n  margin: 1.5rem 0;\n  padding: 0;\n}\n.card {\n  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n  border-radius: 0.75rem;\n  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;\n  background: var(--purple-light);\n  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;\n}\n.card:hover {\n  transform: translateY(-2px);\n  border-color: var(--gold);\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -10px rgba(31, 22, 38, 0.35);\n}\n.card a {\n  text-decoration: none;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n  font-size: 1.1rem;\n}\n.card a:hover { color: var(--gold-dark); }\n.post-meta { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); margin: 0.35rem 0 0; }\n.post-topic-badge {\n  display: inline-block;\n  background: var(--gold);\n  color: #fff;\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.2rem 0.85rem;\n  font-size: 0.8rem;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n.topic-filters {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem;\n  margin: 1.5rem 0;\n}\n.topic-pill {\n  border: 1px solid var(--purple);\n  background: #fff;\n  color: var(--purple-dark);\n  border-radius: 999px;\n  padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;\n  font: inherit;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n.topic-pill.is-active { background: var(--purple); color: #fff; border-color: var(--purple); }\n\n.post-topic-group h2 { margin-top: 2.5rem; }\n\n/* -- a single post --------------------------------------------------- */\n.post h1 { margin-top: 0.75rem; }\n.post-back { margin-top: 2.5rem; }\n\n/* -- footer ----------------------------------------------------------- */\n.site-footer {\n  background: var(--purple-dark);\n  color: #D9CBE8;\n  margin-top: 2rem;\n  padding: 2rem 0 1.5rem;\n}\n.site-footer-nav {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;\n  margin-bottom: 1rem;\n}\n.site-footer-nav a { color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }\n.site-footer-nav a:hover { color: var(--gold); }\n.footer-note { color: #B6A3C7; }\n\n@media (max-width: 480px) {\n  .site-nav, .site-footer-nav { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }\n  .card-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }\n  .hero { padding: 2.5rem 0; }\n  .wrap { padding: 0 1rem; }\n}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _slug_chain(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> list[str]:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return []\n    return [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n\n\ndef _relative_link(from_chain: list[str], to_chain: list[str]) -> str:\n    up = \"../\" * len(from_chain)\n    if not to_chain:\n        return f\"{up}index.html\" if up else \"index.html\"\n    return f\"{up}{'/'.join(to_chain)}/index.html\"\n\n\ndef _furniture(\n    chain: list[str],\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    footer_pages: list[models.Page],\n    chains: dict[int, list[str]],\n) -> tuple[str, list[dict], list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"CSS path, nav, and footer links for the page/post living at `chain` —\n    shared between a Page's own render and each of its Posts' renders.\"\"\"\n    css_path = _relative_link(chain, [])[: -len(\"index.html\")] + \"style.css\"\n    nav = [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, [])}] + [\n        {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n        for c in continents\n    ]\n    footer_links = [\n        {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[f.id])}\n        for f in footer_pages\n    ]\n    return css_path, nav, footer_links\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    all_pages = models.list_all_pages()\n    chains = {p.id: _slug_chain(p, home) for p in all_pages}\n\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n\n    page_template = env.get_template(\"public/page.html\")\n    post_template = env.get_template(\"public/post.html\")\n\n    for page in all_pages:\n        if page.status != \"published\":\n            continue\n        chain = chains[page.id]\n        css_path, nav, footer_links = _furniture(chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains)\n        breadcrumb = [\n            {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[a.id])}\n            for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n        ] + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chain)}]\n        children = [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _relative_link(chain, chains[c.id])}\n            for c in models.list_published_children(page.id)\n        ]\n\n        post_groups = None\n        if models.is_program_page(page):\n            posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n            post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n                posts, lambda post: _relative_link(chain, chain + [post.slug])\n            )\n\n        html = page_template.render(\n            title=page.title,\n            page=page,\n            body_html=markdown.render(page.body),\n            css_path=css_path,\n            nav=nav,\n            breadcrumb=breadcrumb,\n            footer_links=footer_links,\n            children=children,\n            post_groups=post_groups,\n        )\n\n        page_dir = out.joinpath(*chain) if chain else out\n        page_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        (page_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(html)\n\n        if not post_groups:\n            continue\n        for _topic_value, _topic_label, summaries in post_groups:\n            for summary in summaries:\n                post = summary[\"post\"]\n                post_chain = chain + [post.slug]\n                post_css_path, post_nav, post_footer_links = _furniture(\n                    post_chain, home, continents, footer_pages, chains\n                )\n                post_breadcrumb = [\n                    {\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, chains[a.id])}\n                    for a in models.list_ancestors(page)\n                ] + [\n                    {\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, chain)},\n                    {\"title\": post.title, \"href\": _relative_link(post_chain, post_chain)},\n                ]\n                post_html = post_template.render(\n                    title=post.title,\n                    post=post,\n                    topic_label=summary[\"topic_label\"],\n                    author_name=summary[\"author_name\"],\n                    published_date=summary[\"published_date\"],\n                    body_html=markdown.render(post.body),\n                    css_path=post_css_path,\n                    nav=post_nav,\n                    breadcrumb=post_breadcrumb,\n                    footer_links=post_footer_links,\n                    program_href=_relative_link(post_chain, chain),\n                    program_title=page.title,\n                )\n                post_dir = out.joinpath(*post_chain)\n                post_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n                (post_dir / \"index.html\").write_text(post_html)\n\n    return
